Banana Walnut Muffins
By: Anonymous
Published: Tuesday, December 15, 2009 - 11:27pm

Ingredients




3 cups oat bran cereal
3 mediums bananas, mashed
3 egg whites
2 tablespoons corn oil
1 cup flour-2 tbs firmly packed brown sugar
1 tablespoon baking powder
1/4 cup chopped walnuts

Preparation

1 In medium pot, combine cereal, bananas, egg whites, milk, and oil. Blend well and let stand 5 minutes. In large pot, combine flour, sugar, and baking powder. Add cereal mixture to flour mixture, stir well. Spoon into muffin cups. Sprinkle with nuts. Bake in cardboard oven at 400 for 20 minutes. Serve warm.
